crm.strategy

Interface LeadScoringStrategy

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    B2BLeadScoringStrategy, SimpleLeadScoringStrategy

    public interface LeadScoringStrategy
    STRATEGY PATTERN - Lead Scoring Permite folosirea de algoritmi diferiți pentru calcul scor lead, interschimbabili în runtime fără modificarea codului client. Implementări disponibile: - SimpleLeadScoringStrategy: scoring de bază - AdvancedLeadScoringStrategy: scoring complex bazat pe comportament - B2BLeadScoringStrategy: scoring specific clienților corporate
